ideas.pitch: A rapid-inference pipeline combining FastAPI and time-series anomaly detection to identify orbital debris or exoplanet light-curve transit dips from raw telescope feeds.
ideas.title: AstroAnomalies: Real-Time Space Debris and Exoplanet Transit Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the core evaluation criteria of technical skills demonstrated and domain knowledge by handling real astronomical time-series data streams.

ideas.pitch: A web interface that classifies stellar spectra using machine learning while employing SHAP values to explain which spectral lines drove the classification.
ideas.title: SpectraSHAP: Explainable Deep Learning for Star Classification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high domain knowledge with rigorous explainability, satisfying the evaluation criteria for technical execution and clarity of final results.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered agent that translates natural language queries into complex SQL or ADQL commands to fetch and visualize data from public astronomical archives like Gaia or SIMBAD.
ideas.title: CosmoQuery: Natural Language Interface for Astronomical Archives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages text-to-query patterns that have proven successful in previous data hackathons, offering judges a smoothly working live demo.

ideas.pitch: An operations dashboard analyzing simulated satellite telemetry logs to detect early anomalies in orbital decay or power systems before mission failure.
ideas.title: OrbitalGuard: Satellite Telemetry Anomaly & Risk Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors winning log-analysis and anomaly-detection architectures, showcasing robust engineering execution within a tight timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A dashboard ingest engine that processes solar imagery metadata and historical flare rates to predict near-term geomagnetic disturbance risks.
ideas.title: SolarFlarePredictor: Multimodal Space Weather Monitoring Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a critical and novel computational astronomy problem with a tangible, interactive web demo that highlights domain-specific technical mastery.
